title: Fresnel rim glow material with additive shell mode
purpose: Give three.js meshes a view-dependent rim glow, bias + scale * (1 - N.V)^power, either as emission over a Lambert-lit base or alone on an additive glow shell, with an optional pulse and an exact CPU mirror of the rim. Use it for energy cores, pickups, selection highlights and sci-fi props.

engine.name: webgl2_browser
engine.notes: three.js r155 or later passed in as THREE (the shader includes the colorspace_fragment chunk); only 0.186.1 was run.

contract.language: ECMAScript 2020 module; GLSL ES 3.00 through three.js ShaderMaterial

exports.name: createFresnelRimMaterial
exports.summary: The rim material; mode 'opaque' or 'additive'; an unknown option throws TypeError, a value out of range RangeError.

exports.name: fresnelRim
exports.summary: CPU mirror of the GLSL rim: bias + scale * (1 - clamp(cosTheta, 0, 1))^power.

exports.name: fresnelPulse
exports.summary: CPU mirror of the pulse factor: 1 at time 0, dipping to 1 - depth.

exports.name: FRESNEL_RIM_DEFAULTS
exports.summary: Frozen default options; colours are linear RGB triples.

exports.name: FRESNEL_RIM_VERTEX
exports.summary: Vertex stage: world normal and position, InstancedMesh aware.

exports.name: FRESNEL_RIM_FRAGMENT
exports.summary: Fragment stage: rim over a lit base or alone for additive glow, then tone mapping and output colour space.

options.name: mode
options.meaning: opaque adds the rim to a lit base; additive draws only the rim with additive blending and no depth write.

options.name: baseColor
options.meaning: Lit base colour in opaque mode.

options.name: power
options.meaning: Exponent; higher keeps the rim closer to the silhouette.

options.name: bias
options.meaning: Rim added everywhere, even facing the camera.

options.name: scale
options.meaning: Rim added at the silhouette on top of the bias.

options.name: pulseSpeed
options.meaning: Pulse angular speed in radians per second of uTime; 0 turns the pulse off.

options.name: pulseDepth
options.meaning: How far the pulse dims the rim.

options.name: lightDirection
options.meaning: Direction toward the light for the base in world space; normalized.

options.name: ambient
options.meaning: Share of the base colour lit without the light.

limits: An empirical Schlick-style curve for looks, not a physical Fresnel term: there is no index of refraction, reflection or energy conservation. Flat faces seen head-on get only the bias, so boxes glow at grazing angles alone. The base is lit by one direction uniform; three.js scene lights, shadows and fog are ignored, and skinned or morphed meshes are not deformed. The additive shell needs its own slightly larger mesh, and additive blending brightens whatever is behind it. Without a bloom pass the glow does not spread past the silhouette. Written for three.js r155 or later; only 0.186.1 was run, in headless Chrome on SwiftShader WebGL 2.
technique_references: Schlick-style facing-ratio rim, bias + scale * (1 - N.V)^power
Additive glow shell with SRC_ALPHA, ONE blending
